name: Bluegrass Packaging Industries
old_description: As a family owned and operated business, we take pride in being a leading provider of bluegrass packaging in Louisville, KY. Our commitment to quality extends to our contract packaging services, where we work closely with clients as a trusted copacker in the Louisville packaging industry.
about:
Bluegrass Packaging Industries operates from Louisville, Kentucky, as a family-owned and operated business. The company was established to provide packaging solutions in the region, though its founding year and the names of its founders are not publicly disclosed. Its headquarters are located on Collins Lane in Louisville.

The firm specializes in contract packaging and copacking services, offering custom packaging solutions tailored to customer requirements. It functions as a one-stop shop for packaging projects, though specific processes, facility size, headcount, and volume metrics are not published. The company describes itself as a leading provider of packaging in the Louisville area.

The company serves clients seeking packaging support across various industries, but the input does not specify particular sectors or named customers. Its services are marketed broadly to businesses needing contract packaging.

The business emphasizes its family-owned structure and commitment to quality as distinguishing factors, positioning itself as a trusted copacker in the Louisville packaging market. It highlights a quality guarantee and close collaboration with clients as part of its service approach.
